jobs.description:
Main tasks and responsibilities:
 

Your main responsibilities are arranging transport, preparing customs clearance information, and communicating with forwarders and transport partners. You will also manage item data and handle the processing and registration of purchases.
 
 

• Checking and recording invoices in the inventory system related to export. 

• Checking all kinds of documents (transport documents, certificates of origin, certificates of conformity, EUR1, ...) 

• Preparing and providing information required for customs clearance 

• Following up on open orders and taking action to ensure timely shipment. 

• Communicating with forwarders, transport companies, and customs-related stakeholders, including for transport arrangements. 

• Monitor delivery times and prices, take action where necessary 

• Coordinating with various departments, including Customer Service, to ensure the smooth flow of export operations. 

• Back up to the general administrative tasks to support the department 

Profile:
 
 

• A customer-oriented mindset and strong problem-solving skills, combined with a collaborative approach, are essential. 

• The ability to work accurately and with attention to detail is important. 

• Knowledge and/or experience in export procedures and international transport is required. 

• An understanding of customs and excise regulations is considered an advantage. 

• Familiarity with Incoterms, together with technical understanding and an affinity for the product range, is a required. 

• Fluency in both French and English, spoken and written, is essential. 

• Good knowledge and hands-on experience with MS Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook, is necessary.

As Valuer Advisor Assistant, you will support our Valuer Advisors in the valuation of real estate. You are responsible for the preparation, analysis and reporting within the valuation process.
You are part of a team working around one type of real estate (logistics, offices, retail, residential, leisure, healthcare, ...) and you work closely with the other members of this Business Unit.

Your responsibilities:

• File management & preparatory administration
You will support the team in file distribution and further start-up of files. For this, you prepare documents such as appraisal reports and valuation files.
• Processing Sales Requests
Quotation requests reach you by phone or mail and are processed by you. You learn to make price calculations, and answer the requests with quotations, which you actively follow up. You will also request additional information from clients where necessary and ensure that all documents are sent correctly and on time. For larger files, you will help prepare pitches, large quotations and framework agreements
• Ad-hoc Support & Portfolio Updates
You will be the point of contact for a variety of ad-hoc tasks, such as updating client portfolios or processing data. Creating and structuring files in our computer systems is also part of your responsibilities. You provide broad administrative support, also for internal projects such as studies and app development. You support valuer advisors by conducting site visits. 
• You have a bachelor's degree in administration, real estate/an equivalent field or have accumulated equivalent knowledge/experience through projects and work experience.
• You work accurately, independently, efficiently and with an eye for detail
• You are proactive and enjoy planning and structuring
• You communicate and write fluently in Dutch and English as you have regular contact with customers and colleagues. Knowledge of French is a plus.
• You are familiar with MS Office and quickly learn new tools.
• You dare to ask questions and enjoy learning.
We recruit based on competencies and talents, regardless of age, sex, gender, origin or limitation/disability.
 We offer
• An impactful position in which you will actively help build the future of Stadim
• An attractive salary package with extra-legal benefits (insurance, bonus...)
• Internal on-the-job training given by experienced colleagues
• An informal, collegial work environment with room for initiative
• A genuine commitment to work-life balance
• A challenging entry-level position with growth opportunities towards Valuer Advisor

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?

As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner

• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products

• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation

• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy

• Processing payments and handling cash register duties

• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service

• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule

• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage

• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently

• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages

• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries

• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

The Field Service Technician is responsible for carrying out services and maintenance at Customer Installations and where applicable as well for assembly and dismantling. 

Will maintain, repair and perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance of Air Liquide installations (PG,Cryo, bulk & On Sites) and equipment at customer sites within the assigned budget. 

He/She executes the maintenance work according to procedures and standards. After each work execution, the technician manages his intervention report signed by the customers and communicates with the Maintenance Planner to ensure quality and integrity of the data. 

Provide On-site support for testing, and troubleshooting. 

He/she provides a high level of quality of service to customers in the assigned area and ensures legal and IMS compliance. 

He/she implements the environmental legislation, works in line with the ISO 14001 standard, , respects the good environmental practices and shows a positive attitude with regard to the preservation of the environment 

 

Performs preventive & corrective maintenance
 
 

• Executes preventive maintenance according to planning, with sub-contractor if required. 

• Performs the all kind of maintenance work on PG, Bulk & On Sites according procedure and standard 

• Contact the maintenance planners if corrective maintenance is required. 

• Prepares reports and obtains the customer signature on maintenance intervention report. 

• Confirms data in SAP (kilometers-time-spare parts used-cause of failure...)  

 
 

Repairs and troubleshooting of equipment failures
 
 

• The FST will execute the intervention once the work is confirmed by the maintenance planner and spare parts are available. 

• Will analyzes and identifies malfunctions as well determines the necessary repairs, and carries them out (with subcontractor if applicable). 

• Will communicate the spare parts used and obtain the intervention report signed by the customer.  

 
 

Ensures all quality & safety procedures are followed
 
 

• Understands and adheres to all relevant IMS procedures within the scope of their qualifications 

• Ensures Compliances and applies IMS and legal rules. 

• Knows and respects the country SOPs and standards 

•    

Reports accurate and up-to-date maintenance information
 
 

• Communicates with the Maintenance planner to ensure quality and integrity of the data. 

• Confirms completion of work after site visit 

• Writes consolidated reports on quality defects and customer complaints  

 
 

Communicates potential problems that may affect safety, reliability & quality
 
 

• Identifies through experience and troubleshooting analysis the dysfunctionment of gas equipments 

• Observes work area(s) and is alert to and avoids unsafe behaviors and conditions or other hazards 

• Participates in corrective measures when appropriate or authorized  

 
 

Face to face with the customers & internal sales force
 
 

• Communicates professionally and respectfully with customers. 

• Supports the project team with assembly and dismantling if applicable, as well as new or retrofit PG, Bulk, on Site, cryo or MGPS projects. 

• Respects and promotes the Zero safety incident goal 

• Ensure operational readiness of service vehicles, PPE, tools, and work equipment. 

• Participate in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of normal business hours 

Experience
 
 

• Good troubleshooting skills 

• Good understanding of operations & safety procedures 

• Capable to analyse trends, problems & cause-effects 

• Understanding of procedures and regulatory for new and existing industrial installations 

• Good knowledge maintenance activities 

• Technical understanding of gas physical and production processes 

• Good understanding of Safety procedures  

 
 

Competencies:
 

Hard skills:
 
 

• Language proficiency 

• Fluent in Dutch 

• Pre-intermediate English 

• Maintenance tools & methods (SAP) 

• IMS 

• Google tools 

• Telemetry applications 

• Mechanical and /or electrical and / or automation knowledge  

Soft skills : 
 
 

• Promoting and supporting actions towards Safety, Health and environment protection 

• Encourages questioning of established ideas and practices and ask why regularly and provide deliverables on time 

• Good communication with the different stakeholders 

• Customer mindset & team player 

• Team player 

• Striving for continuous improvement

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Your key responsibilities:
	
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.	
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.	
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.	
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.	
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:
	
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.	
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 	
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.	
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.	
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.	
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.	
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager – Corporate | MICE | Leisure | Airline
jobs.description:
Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is one of Belgium's leading upscale business hotels, ideally located in 

Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport and NATO headquarters. With 315 stylish guestrooms, 

18 state-of-the-art meeting spaces, newly refreshed extensive meeting- and event facilities and a strong 

international corporate clientele, the hotel is recognized as a premier destination for meetings, conferences 

and business travel. Join a dynamic commercial team where innovation, relationship-building and driving 

results are at the heart of everything we do.
 

Ready to hunt, win and grow?
 

We're looking for a driven Sales Manager who loves opening new doors, building strong client relationships 

and closing deals. This is a true business development role. Your mission is simple: generate new business 

across our Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments and help position Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport 

as the preferred hotel in the market.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Hunt for new business opportunities and build your own client portfolio. 

• Negotiate and close commercial agreements. 

• Develop and manage a strong sales pipeline using our CRM. 

• Identify market trends and new business opportunities. 

• Work closely with our commercial and operational teams to deliver outstanding guest 

Who you are
• A natural hunter with a passion for sales.

• A bachelor’s degree
 or equivalent in Hotel Management/Business Administration, 
or equivalent experience.

• Experienced in business development: hospitality experience is a strong advantage.

• Confident negotiator with a results-driven mindset.

• Comfortable working with a CRM and sales targets.

• Fluent in English and either French 
or Dutch.

• Flexible to meet clients and attend events outside standard office hours when required.

Your Responsibilities

 
• 
 
Unpack, sort, and repack lingerie collections for various pop-up stores.

 
 
• 
 
Handle stock transfers, load and unload goods, and maintain correct stock organization.

 
 
• 
 
Ensure all items are prepared and ready for presentation.

 
 
• 
 
Work schedule: 10:00 to 18:00.

 
 
• 
 
Flexibility is essential — Saturday work is required.

 

 

What We Expect

 
• 
 
Flexible attitude and comfortable working in a dynamic retail and logistics environment.

 
 
• 
 
Willing to travel to different locations; Saturday availability is mandatory.

 
 
• 
 
Driving license B required (own car not needed).

 
 
• 
 
Good command of English.

 
 
• 
 
No previous experience needed — full training is provided.

 
 
• 
 
Detail-oriented and motivated to work with lingerie collections in a professional setting.

• You check and handle glass bottles at the end of the production line

• You cool and pack finished products according to guidlines

• You work with automated inspection systems to detect defects

• You also carry out manual quality checks when needed

• You identify errors and adjust the process to improve quality and efficiency

• You help keep the production safe and running smoothly

• Experience in production or strong interest in production work

• You work accurately and follow quality standards

• Technical insight to understand machines and processes

• You can work with computer systems

• You are not color blind (quality control requirement)

• You speak and understand English well

Responsibilities
 
 

• Study, specification, design and verification of high-quality digital and mixed-signal ICs 

• Write digital specifications for mixed-signal ICs, make area and power estimations 

• Technical team lead for the digital content of mixed-signal ASICs including interaction with customers, suppliers and the internal ASIC development team 

• Lead, attend and present at project/review meetings worldwide 

• Coach junior engineers in design, verification and testing of integrated circuits and improve their level of technical expertise and knowledge of the total business 

• Work together with international customers and communicate efficiently to successfully complete the project 

• Write documentation 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer with at least four years of experience in digital IC design 

• You have experience with front-end ASIC or FPGA design in VHDL and/or Verilog and/or SystemVerilog 

• You have experience with front-end verification, preferably in SystemVerilog + UVM, to write directed tests, constrained randomized tests and to gather and interpret metrics such as code/condition/FSM/toggle/functional coverage 

• You have experience with digital synthesis, logic equivalence checking (LEC) and Static Timing Analysis (STA) 

• Experience with UPF and/or CPF and DFT and ATPG is a plus 

• Experience with scripting and programming languages such as Python and C is a plus 

• Experience with any of the following protocols and techniques is a plus: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, LIN, SENT, DSP, CRC, FSM design, MCU 

• You are a self-motivated, efficient professional able to work alone or in teams 

• You offer quality and reliability to colleagues, customers and management, willing to share knowledge and able to communicate efficiently 

• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken

Scope
 

The project leader’s role is to technically manage IC design and supply projects to ensure technical quality and timely delivery. 
 

Responsibilities
 

Be the technical lead for an entire project, taking into account customer milestones and making sure technical specifications and quality standards are met:
 
 

• Daily follow-up of all project team members: designers, layouters, testers 

• Support and coach team members with technical expertise and strong problem solving skills 

• Maintain detailed overview and knowledge of the complete mixed-signal development 

• Organize, lead, attend internal status meetings to keep abreast about the project progress 

• Be the technical point of contact for the customer 

• Write the IC design specification and ensure a timely update in case of customer change requests 

• Ensure compliance with all safety and quality standards 

• Closely work together with and report potential problems on time to the Project Manager  
  
 

Competences
 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer in micro-electronics 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant industrial work experience 

• You are an experienced user of the mixed-signal flow of Cadence and/or Synopsys and Matlab 

• You have strong communication and reporting skills, also in English 

• You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem solving skills

Are you a financial expert and does accounting have no secrets for you? Do you like studying figures and do you like to have ownership? Then the position of Accounting Specialist at Miele Belux is your next career step! In this position, you are the pivot between the financial processes, the people and the resulting administration. Together with the controllers, shared service centre and external parties, such as our accountants and advisors, you ensure accurate accounting. This not only involves the correct administration of the figures, but also identifying bottlenecks and risks in terms of legislation and regulations. You will be working in a multinational team, with a manager who focuses on your talents and prepares you for a great career within Miele. The many international contacts within the Miele group offer you the opportunity to build an interesting network.
 

What you will be doing:
 

The Accounting Specialist plays a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization by ensuring accurate financial record-keeping, timely processing of transactions, and compliance with group financial policies and local regulatory requirements. The role supports effective financial management through attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to excellence. You are the first point of contact within the Belgium affiliate and the right hand of the Accounting Manager covering the cluster of Belgium/Luxembourg/Netherlands/France.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities for the Belgian entity in collaboration with our global shared services (MGS) teams in Poland. 

• Ensure accurate bookings, accruals, reconciliations, and allocations to cost and profit centers. 

• Be a key point of contact for external and internal audit matters. 

• Support tax and legal compliance processes, including VAT, and other statutory declarations. 

• Evaluate internal systems, controls, and risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

• Contribute to Belgian and global process optimization projects. 

• Support the FP&A team with financial transparency, reporting, and follow-up.  

 

The Accounting Specialist we are looking for:
 

We are looking for someone who is structured, accountable, and principled, with a strong sense of ownership for financial integrity and operational follow-through. You enjoy working with both numbers and practical coordination, and you are comfortable communicating with internal stakeholders as well as external service partners.
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, economics, business administration. 

• +8 years of experience in a similar role. 

• A strong accounting foundation, with proven experience in closing periods, balance sheet ownership, statutory and tax reporting. 

• Handles sensitive financial information with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability while adhering to professional and organizational standards. 

• Communicates financial information clearly and professionally to colleagues, management, auditors, and other stakeholders. 

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a passion for continuous improvement and eagerness to take ownership, contribute to harmonization of processes across the region. 

• Works collaboratively across departments and builds positive relationships. 

• Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• Experience in a multinational, multi-location matrix environment.. 

• Experience working with SAP is an advantage, proficiency in Excel. 

• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch/French, both written and verbal.

Are you physically strong? Not afraid of a bit of hard work? Start immediately as a removal worker in a stable team with fair pay. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a removal worker and packer with experience and the right attitude to carry out removal projects professionally and with care.
 

Your duties

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.
